name: end_call
description: Ends the call gracefully after a confirmed outcome. Use it only when the conversation is truly finished: every query answered and every outcome settled (booking confirmed and the goodbye done, callback wrap-up complete, or the prospect clearly said goodbye). Always confirm next steps, ask if anything else is needed, say goodbye warmly, then end. NEVER use it mid-conversation to escape confusion, an objection, a failed tool call, or an unbooked prospect — every stage has a fallback; follow it instead.

name: extract_volunteered_details
description: Capture identity details ONLY when the prospect volunteers them unprompted. Never ask for these directly — asking belongs to a later stage.

variables.name: first_name
variables.description: Their first name, exactly as they said it.

variables.name: last_name
variables.description: Their last name if they volunteer it.

variables.name: company_name
variables.description: Company/business name as they call it.

variables.name: industry
variables.description: Their trade/industry if evident from what they said.
